title: Rangka app overlay
description: Company layer for an app's menu, in <site>/custom/app.<app>.rk (contract 0049): the company's words for the app's menu groups and sub-menus. Only labels change; the groups, their order and their models stay the app's.

app.description: The app or module whose menu this file renames; must equal the file name after app.

menu_labels.description: By the Indonesian text of a group or sub-menu label as written in the app's app.rk ("Alat dan pelanggan"), the company's label for it
